title: Notifications
description: Get a push notification when something needs you — a prompt, a failed verification, an upstream API fault, or a session that could not start — even when the app is closed. Completions are optional.
enabledOnThisDevice: Notifications are enabled on this device.

types.heading: Notify me about
types.promptWaitingDesc: A prompt waiting for you, a failed verification gate, an upstream API fault, or a session that could not start. Nothing moves until you do
types.completionDesc: Ordinary completions that need nothing from you. Off by default on newly registered devices (change it for this device here)

permission.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. Allow them for this site to receive push notifications.

unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
notConfigured: Push notifications are not configured on this server. Set the VAPID keys to enable them.

ios.guidance: On iPhone/iPad, add this app to your Home Screen and open it from there to enable notifications.

toast.disabled: Notifications turned off on this device

push.stillWaitingPrompt: Still waiting for your reply ({minutes} min)
push.stillWaitingTerminal: Still needs attention in the terminal ({minutes} min)
push.failureUpstreamWithExcerpt: Stalled by an upstream API fault: {excerpt}
push.failureUpstream: Stalled by an upstream API fault

escalation.heading: Reminder
escalation.toggleDesc: Send one more notification when an agent has been waiting this long. Applies to every device.

inApp.heading: In-app notifications
inApp.waitingToggleDesc: Show a toast when another worktree starts waiting for you
inApp.soundToggleDesc: Play a short chime when a worktree starts waiting for you. Takes effect after you click or press a key on the page.
